extraction.Name: Edith Emery
extraction.Recorded patent: On October 21, 1920, the patent was recorded by F. O. Leggett
extraction.Buyer: Edith Emery Crane conveyed the land by deed to W. H. Tackett for $1800
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612712 issued; Southwest quarter section 4, township 38, range 27; receipt for patent signed February 8, 1918 by the allottee; conveyance dated May 24, 1921; allottee also referred to as Edith Emery Crane
